scheme_name: Scholarship To 2 Years Pre-Service Student Teachers Undergoing D.El.Ed Programme At DIETs And CTTC Sohra
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya
Must have passed Class XII or equivalent with at least 50% marks (5% relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD)
Candidates awaiting Class XII results may apply if they can produce provisional/original documents at counseling
At least 30% of seats are reserved for candidates with Science and Mathematics backgrounds at Class XII level
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹5000 per month for 2 years (10 months per year).
